changelog: v0.7 release: Fixed critical cross-provider cache collision where EpisodeCacheManager shared episode disk directories across providers, causing multiplexed audio+video streams (such as AnimeSuge) to load video-only cached segments from dual-track providers (such as Miruro), completely silencing audio and stalling decoder playback at 00:03. Episode disk caches are now strictly isolated per provider and audio mode. Expanded real-time audio and playhead anomaly detection: active HLS audio track listeners, Chromium audio decoded byte count health monitoring, audio buffer underflow warnings, playhead freeze detection, snap-to-zero recovery, and unexpected forward/backward skip tracking.
